title: Introduction
use_cases: Use when evaluating the transition from traditional to digital publishing models
Implement when developing a long-term professional strategy for online literary careers
Use when comparing ecosystem-based distribution against legacy publishing gatekeepers
content:
Digital publishing has fundamentally reshaped the literary landscape. Where writers once depended on institutional gatekeepers, they now operate within platform ecosystems that combine distribution, discovery, monetization, and community into a single infrastructure. This shift has created unprecedented opportunity, but it has also introduced new complexity. Success today requires not only strong storytelling, but strategic literacy.

This article examines web novels vs traditional publishing through a professional lens, focusing on long-term career durability rather than temporary growth hacks.
